title: Compliance Statement on Exhaustion of the Plan Appeal: Appeals and Grievances
content:
**Appeals and Grievances**: a State Fair Hearing or External Medical Review may be requested only after the plan's own Standard or Expedited Appeal of the same decision was resolved upheld or partially overturned, or, where deemed exhaustion applies to the case type requested, when that appeal was not resolved by its due date.

## Statement

1. **Gate.** An escalated case is opened only when the prior plan appeal named as the case it is escalated from is resolved upheld or partially overturned, or is past its due date unresolved where deemed exhaustion applies.
2. **Evidence.** The gate is read from the plan's own record of that prior plan appeal, identified by its case number: its status, its resolution and its due date. It is checked before the escalated case is opened. The prior plan appeal must be the plan's Standard Appeal or Expedited Appeal of the same decision.
3. **After filing.** The plan sends its case summary to the hearing office or review organization within the case type's summary period of the filed date, and the hearing office or review organization decides. Its decision binds the plan. Each summary sent is recorded with the date it was sent and its delivery channel.

## Truth table for the gate

The gate is stated as an "only when", so every combination below has a definite answer.

| Prior plan appeal of the same decision | Deemed exhaustion applies to the case type requested | Escalated case opened |
|---|---|---|
| Resolved, upheld | Either | Yes |
| Resolved, partially overturned | Either | Yes |
| Resolved, overturned | Either | No |
| Withdrawn | Either | No |
| Filed, acknowledged or under review, due date passed | Yes | Yes |
| Filed, acknowledged or under review, due date passed | No | No |
| Filed, acknowledged or under review, due date not yet passed | Either | No |
| No plan appeal of the same decision | Either | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A member's Standard Appeal of a pharmacy exception denial was resolved upheld. An escalated case naming that appeal meets the gate.
- A member's Expedited Appeal was resolved overturned. It is not resolved upheld or partially overturned and is not unresolved, so it does not open an escalated case.
- A member's Standard Appeal is still under review and its due date has passed. The gate is met for a case type to which deemed exhaustion applies and not met for one to which it does not.
